title: A Cross-model Fusion-aware Framework for Optimizing (gather-matmul-scatter)s Workload
problem: Modern sparse and irregular neural networks (RGCN, SpConv, MoE) rely on gather-matmul-scatter workloads, but existing optimizations lack cross-model transferability, require expensive search, and cannot handle dynamic inputs efficiently.
motivation: Gather-matmul-scatter is a bottleneck in sparse neural networks; optimizations must adapt across models and handle dynamic sparsity patterns.
method: Efficient-GMS proposes a fusion-aware framework with dataflow analysis to identify shared patterns and four optimized dataflow variants using vertical/horizontal fusion. A performance model predicts execution efficiency to reduce search space, and a lightweight heuristic selects optimal dataflow based on input characteristics and hardware.
key_novelty: Cross-model fusion-aware dataflow patterns that transfer optimizations across RGCN, SpConv, and MoE without model-specific retuning.
contributions: Fusion-aware framework enabling cross-model optimization migration via comprehensive dataflow analysis
Performance model-guided configuration space reduction that minimizes search time while ensuring optimal selection
Adaptive dataflow selection mechanism that dynamically chooses patterns based on input and hardware characteristics
limitations: Evaluation limited to three model types; scalability to other sparse neural network patterns not discussed.
